documents_expected.why: programme page: deadline notice, organisation eligibility, grant types
2026 applicant guide: eligibility, match, required materials, deadlines, reporting

eligibility.rule: Local governments, tribes, lake districts and colleges are eligible outright
eligibility.quote: Counties, municipalities, natural resource agencies, tribal governing bodies, other local units of government, accredited colleges, universities, technical schools, lake districts and town sanitary districts are automatically eligible to apply for a Surface Water Grant.

eligibility.rule: Lake and river associations, nonprofits and school districts must first be approved as eligible (by 1 May)
eligibility.quote: Qualified lake associations, qualified surface water management organizations, qualified river management organizations, nonprofit conservation organizations and qualified school districts must apply for eligibility before applying for a surface water grant.

eligibility.rule: Eligibility reviewed every 10 years or when bylaws change
eligibility.quote: An organization's eligibility needs to be reviewed every 10 years or when the bylaws are changed.

eligibility.rule: Plan implementation and AIS management need an approved plan recommendation
eligibility.quote: A request for Determination of Eligibility is required for applications submitted to the Management Plan Implementation and AIS Population Management grant categories.

eligibility.rule: Direct administration capped at 10% of the award
eligibility.quote: only 10% of the state share (i.e. award amount) may be spent on direct administrative costs

eligibility.rule: Restoration sites stay in conservation use for 20 years
eligibility.quote: The grantee shall have control of the property through ownership, easements, deed restrictions, or contracts such that the sites being restored with grant funds remain in conservation use for 20 years.

documents.item: Authorizing resolution signed by a governing-body member
documents.quote: Authorizing resolution (Form 8700-388 or a substantially similar document) signed by a member of the governing body who is NOT recognized as an authorized representative within the resolution.

documents.item: Map of the project location and public access
documents.quote: Map of project location, public access, public land and other use and access features
Completed current Project Lab Costs Form (Form 8700-360) (if applicable).

documents.item: Letters of commitment or support (if applicable)
documents.quote: Letters of commitment or support (if applicable).

documents.item: On public land: land use agreement or letter of intent
documents.quote: For projects on public land: a land use agreement or a letter of intent from the property manager.
For surface water restoration projects: project design plan.

documents.item: Organisational eligibility application (Form 8700-380), for groups that need it
documents.quote: applicants who need to apply for eligibility should submit Grant Eligibility Application Form 8700-380 and supporting documentation to their regional environmental grant specialist.

effort.quote: By May 1 of each year, applicants who need to apply for eligibility should submit Grant Eligibility Application Form 8700-380

effort.step: Email the final application to DNR
effort.quote: All emailed applications must be sent to DNRSurfaceWaterGrants@wisconsin.gov by 11:59 pm on Monday, November 16th.

co_finance_required.quote: The minimum percentage of the total project costs required as grantee match is determined by the grant category.

after_award.quote: submit quarterly and/or final reports to the department to satisfy the grant agreement

notes: Grantee match: 33% for education and planning, 25% for management grants, so the programme minimum is 25%. The 2026 final deadline was 16 November (15 November fell on a Sunday); the next cycle's dates aren't published, so no later due date. Grants reimburse costs. Healthy Lakes & Rivers, Clean Boats Clean Waters and land acquisition have their own rules.
